HOW IT WORKS
Tap the bubble to open the panel; tap it again to fold it away.
Drag the bubble anywhere — it rests against the nearest edge.
Drag it onto the ✕ at the bottom to close it, use Stop in the notification, or the BrawlZone tile in Quick Settings — that tile also starts it, from inside the game.
